第426章 三步破阵一线葬命（第1页）
四面阵光向内收拢的刹那，顾昭衡横剑踏前。
方背古剑刚刚触上正面灰光，覆在剑外的罡气便被从中切开。
顾昭衡两只虎口的旧裂再次绽开，鲜血沿着剑柄向下淌落。她双脚贴着石阶，向后滑出半步。
只是，当周世荣的一个‘谢’字刚刚说出，他突然现，自己的嘴巴竟然无法说话了。
托叶白的福，宋曦也不止一次进警局，更不止一次与林菲打交道了。
理仁立即吩咐制陶师父加紧多多制作相同粘土类型的坩埚，连续制作了二十多个，这种专用粘土终于是告竭。理仁这才放下手来准备开始炼制钢铁。
三天三夜中，常胜天几次被王嘲笑的‘冥合摧化掌’击入绝境，但每次都以绝伦的玄斗三步风影侥幸逃离。等到王嘲笑以风、雷双系魔法归元，以斗气化脉，最终使出‘冥合魔武脉阳指’将常胜天重创身体。
同时，其他逃出来的长老也嘶吼着一起向尧慕尘冲来，手中的各种法宝纷纷冲向高空，眼看就要朝尧慕尘这里轰下来。
这些天，他在继续研究补天丹的炼制方法，却始终没有丝毫的突破。
“你们谁才是我最后的对手呢？”看着两招强大的战技即将碰撞出他们最绚烂的火花，狼宏翔心中只有战意，一股股不断升腾而起的战意。
这四个警察都是城北分局刑警队的，其中一人就是队长刘宏，叶白曾在城北分局出过风头，被他救过的叫做谢伟的警员此刻也在这里，这四人当然对叶白印象深刻。
虽然已经可谓是山穷水尽，无路可退，但是冯勇也没有让手下开枪，只是带着大家挥舞砍刀和钢管，赤膊上阵，短兵厮杀。
不同世界同样名字的东西很多都是截然不同的，比如说杨戬的天眼在宝莲灯中是一件法宝，但在其它世界之中却是杨戬天生的神目，弱水同样也是如此。
因此，此刻亡灵宝典储存的精神力和魔法师几乎可以让聂风瞬间冲刺亡灵魔导士这个瓶颈了，但聂风却仍不自知。
当然，在这之前，他也检查了一边护道人的尸体，确认他已经魂飞魄散，也从摇光圣子处印证了自己得到的不灭天功的确是真的。
这工作人怎么这么不耐烦呢！已经暗中骂我两次！不过杨任没有计较，因为他的注意力全部放着寻找赝品之上。
于是屁颠屁颠的对着杨聪说道:“这位少爷稍等，马上就上菜。”这可是个大财主，可不能得罪了。转身便走向柜台。

好吧，我也不想做什么无意义的争斗，看它的样子，估计也不是什么好吃的玩意，反正它的样子没办法让我提起享用它的想法。
“这网兜这么坚韧？”龙五美目中神光闪烁，从树顶上飘然落在杨任身边，若有所思地凝视着网兜。
随后，手中储物戒指白光一闪，在藏剑长老手中就出现一块黑色的石头。
他忽然很想听涟漪说话，细细的、弱弱的腔调并不像处心积虑修饰过。
这一幕只看得聂风心中一阵抽搐，妈~的！这些恐怖的树木到底是什么东西！简直就是吸血的魔鬼，炸都炸不死。
一夜无话，第二天一大早我就从床上爬了起来，最近生物钟调得很准时，一到点就醒。

Chapter 426: Break the formation in three steps and die on the line (page 1)
The moment the array of lights on all sides closed inward, Gu Zhaoheng stepped forward with his sword.
As soon as the square-backed ancient sword touched the gray light on the front, the Gang Qi covering the sword was cut through.
The old cracks in Gu Zhaoheng's two tiger's mouths opened again, and blood dripped down along the hilts of the swords. She put her feet against the stone steps and slid half a step back.
However, when Zhou Shirong said the word "thank you", he suddenly found that his mouth could not speak.
Thanks to Ye Bai, Song Xi also entered the police station more than once, and dealt with Lin Fei more than once.
Rihito immediately ordered the pottery master to make more crucibles of the same type of clay. He made more than 20 crucibles in a row. This kind of special clay was finally exhausted. Riren then put down his hands and prepared to start refining steel.
During the three days and nights, Chang Shengtian was knocked into desperate situations several times by Wang's ridiculed 'Minghe Destroying Palm', but he managed to escape each time with the unparalleled Xuan Dou Three Steps Feng Ying. When Wang Xiao used the magic of wind and thunder to return to his origin, he used fighting energy to transform his veins, and finally used the 'Minghe Demonic Martial Vein Yang Finger' to severely injure Chang Shengtian's body.
At the same time, the other elders who had escaped screamed and rushed towards Yao Muchen. The various magic weapons in their hands rushed high into the sky, and were about to hit Yao Muchen.
These days, he continued to study the refining method of the Heaven-Building Pill, but there was still no breakthrough.
"Which of you will be my final opponent?" Seeing that the two powerful combat skills were about to collide to create their most brilliant sparks, Lang Hongxiang only had fighting spirit in his heart, a rising fighting spirit.
These four policemen are all from the Criminal Police Team of the Chengbei Branch. One of them is the captain Liu Hong. Ye Bai once was famous in the Chengbei Branch. The policeman named Xie Wei who he rescued is also here at the moment. Of course, these four people are deeply impressed by Ye Bai.
Although they were at the end of their rope and had no way out, Feng Yong did not let his men shoot. He just led everyone to fight with machetes and steel pipes, shirtless, in hand-to-hand combat.
Many things with the same name in different worlds are completely different. For example, Yang Jian's Heavenly Eye is a magic weapon in the Lotus Lamp, but in other worlds it is Yang Jian's natural divine eye. The same is true for Weoshui.
Therefore, at this moment, the mental power and magicians stored in the Book of the Undead can almost allow Nie Feng to sprint through the bottleneck of the undead magicians in an instant, but Nie Feng still does not know it.
Of course, before that, he also checked the body of the guardian on one side and confirmed that his soul was gone. He also confirmed from the Holy Son of Light that the immortal power he had obtained was indeed true.
Why is this worker so impatient! Already scolded me twice! But Yang Ren didn't care, because all his attention was on finding fakes.
So he said to Yang Cong nonchalantly: "This young master, wait a moment, the food will be served immediately." This is a rich man, so he cannot offend him. He turned around and walked towards the counter.
Well, I don’t want to engage in a meaningless fight. Judging from the looks of it, it’s probably not a delicious thing. Anyway, its appearance doesn’t make me think about enjoying it.
"Is this net bag so tough?" Long Wumei's eyes flickered as he floated down from the top of the tree to Yang Ren's side, staring at the net bag thoughtfully.
Then, the storage ring in his hand flashed with white light, and a black stone appeared in the hand of Elder Zangjian.
He suddenly wanted to hear Lianyi speak. Her thin, weak tone didn't seem to have been deliberately modified.
This scene only made Nie Feng's heart twitch, damn! What are these scary trees! They are simply blood-sucking devils that cannot be killed even if they are exploded.
Nothing to say all night, and early the next morningI climbed out of bed. Recently, my biological clock has been set on time and I wake up as soon as one o'clock arrives.
